metadata.description: Mobile engineering skills for React Native teams shipping to the App Store and Google Play.

plugins.name: rn-store-compliance
plugins.description: Dual-store review auditor for React Native / Expo. Ships two skills: rn-ios-review (Apple App Store Review Guidelines, sections 1-5) and rn-android-review (Google Play policies plus the Console gates that block an upload). Includes standalone static scanners for each platform, a cross-store divergences reference, and health/regulated modules for HIPAA-adjacent apps.
